set.body:
Goal: define exactly which EyeLink ASC grammar, converter modes, coordinate modes, sample layouts, hardware generations, and edge cases eyes4s claims to support.

Acceptance criteria:
- Supported/unsupported matrix covers converter identity, samples/events/both, GAZE/HREF/RAW, left/right/binocular, remote/head-fixed, optional velocity/resolution/input/button fields, message offsets, and multiple recording blocks.
- Each supported cell names at least one fixture or planned fixture; absent evidence is labelled unvalidated rather than inferred.
- Coordinate, pupil, missingness, native-event, clock, message-offset, encoding, and unknown-record policies are explicit.
- The designated sources are SR Research EDF2ASC documentation, ASC Programmer Guide/read_asc reference behavior, and versioned local decision records.
- The contract names exact field-specific equality or tolerance rules used by conformance tests.
- Scope explicitly excludes reverse-engineering EDF and treating native EyeLink events as eyes4s detector output.
set.title: Define the EyeLink ASC support contract and capability matrix
